newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Friday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 200 heifers;
1,700 head confirmed for the week which includes 1,400 head or
35 loads CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs
66.00, North Plains. Slaughter Heifers - Few pens mostly
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
